topic: Stock Purchases and Sales: Long and Short
source_evidence: If the price of the stock rises and you buy it back later at the higher price, you will incur a loss.
question: Misconception: A short seller profits when the stock price rises after they sell it.
answer: A short seller generally hopes the price will fall so they can buy the stock back at a lower price. If the price rises before they buy it back, they pay more to close the position and incur a loss.
